# TopologyAware_Reservoir

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A reservoir computing architecture where the reservoir's connectivity matrix is derived from the underlying network topology rather than being random. Leverages existing network structure to improve computational capacity and reduce training complexity in topology-centric systems.
